findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.citation_text:
2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM). (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

On arrival there was not a CFPM available at the facility. A CFPM arrived shortly into the inspection to correct. Ensure that there are sufficient CFPMs on staff to have one at the facility at all times that foods are being handled/prepared.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.citation_text:
3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display.

Raw eggs were oberved over both cooked and raw bacon in the standing cooler in the kitchen. The PIC was shown and moved the items to correct. Ensure that storage locations for the raw foods in the facility are maintained so that cross contamination is safe in relation to the safe cooking temperatures of the foods involved.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.citation_text:
4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

The facility could not provide test strips for the sanitizer used in the facility during the inspection. A follow-up is being scheduled for 10 days to verify compliance. Ensure that test kits are available for the sanitizer solutions in the facility at all times.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

The three part sink was observed pulling away from the wall in the kitchen and exposing a gap that is not easily cleanable. The PIC was shown and instructed to reseal prior to the next routine inspection. Ensure that all surfaces around moisture and food surfaces are smooth and easily cleanable at all times.
